name: acme-web-3f
title: Checkout page layout shift
firstPrompt: The checkout page jumps when the promo banner loads. Find out what causes the layout shift and fix it.
asks: Run the Lighthouse CI check again and compare CLS before and after
Also reserve space for the shipping estimate, it shifts on slow 3G
Open a PR with the fix and link WEB-1482
lastReply: The banner image had no intrinsic size, so the browser reserved 0px until it loaded. I added width/height attributes and an aspect-ratio fallback, and reserved a min-height for the shipping estimate. CLS on /checkout dropped from 0.31 to 0.02 in Lighthouse CI.
